SELECT e.device_name as attrName, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(g.mete_name) AND ISNULL(a.inspection_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(g.mete_name) THEN a.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(a.inspection_name) THEN g.mete_name ELSE CONCAT(g.mete_name,'/',a.inspection_name) END) AS instance_name, f.instance_id FROM t_cruise_point_instance f left join (SELECT DISTINCT device_id,device_name from t_std_device) e on e.device_id = f.device_id left join t_robot_inspection a on f.cruise_id = a.inspection_id left join t_std_devicemete g on f.device_mete_id = g.device_mete_id WHERE f.instance_id in #{instanceId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT DISTINCT e.robot_code FROM t_cruise_task a , t_cruise_task_attr b , t_cruise_point_instance c ,t_robot_inspection d ,t_robot_info e where 1=1 and a.task_id = b.task_id and b.instance_id = c.instance_id and c.cruise_id = d.inspection_id and d.robot_id = e.robot_id and a.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT DISTINCT d.task_id FROM t_robot_inspection a, t_cruise_point_instance b, t_cruise_task_attr c, t_cruise_result d WHERE a.robot_id = #{robotId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND a.inspection_id = b.cruise_id AND b.instance_id = c.instance_id AND c.task_id = d.task_id AND ( d.c_state = 239 OR d.c_state = 241 ) AND d.c_type != 508 AND d.c_type != 509 AND d.c_type != 456 ORDER BY d.create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT (CASE WHEN a.c_state = 239 THEN a.task_id ELSE "" END) AS taskId, (CASE WHEN a.c_state = 239 THEN "正在执行" ELSE "" END) AS taskState, (CASE WHEN a.c_state = 239 THEN a.task_name ELSE "" END) AS taskName FROM t_cruise_result a LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_attr b ON b.task_id = a.task_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance c ON c.instance_id = b.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection d ON d.inspection_id = c.cruise_id WHERE d.robot_id = #{robotId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ( a.c_type = 508 OR a.c_type = 509 OR a.c_type = 456 ) ORDER BY a.create_time DESC LIMIT 1;
